authority_boundary: Living-repository automation may discover evidence and prepare bounded internal screening, attack, replication, adjudication, and promotion-proposal artifacts only on explicitly noncanonical automation/review surfaces. Those artifacts do not establish accepted support, dispute, novelty, priority, external validity, utility, independence, theorem status, EFR result, or a canonical Project FAR change. Human merge through the protected path remains the authority boundary for accepted intellectual content and all canonical repository state.

stages.description: Source metadata matched governed search and triage rules.
Primary source identity/content and relevance may be screened automatically on a bounded review surface; the result remains a proposal until human merge.
Automation may reconstruct the exact affected claim and execute a bounded falsification/derivation attack; the result remains internal and noncanonical.
Automation may perform an internal same-provider replication role. It never counts as external independence or final external replication.
Automation may assemble complete review/adjudication artifacts and mark them ready for human acceptance. It may not self-accept them into protected authority.

Automation may prepare the minimal exact correction proposal, payloads, dependency fallout, and proposed authorization bytes. No proposal is mechanically promotable until a human merges the corresponding protected review PR.
Only the protected human-merge path may land accepted scientific or implementation changes on main.

transition_rule: No stage may be skipped. The autonomous-review path may traverse SCREENED through PROMOTION_PROPOSED only on explicitly noncanonical surfaces under the bounded FAR-LIVING-AUTONOMOUS-REVIEW-001 contract. Automation must preserve exact source and claim bindings, fail closed on unresolved gates, and may only prepare proposed authorization bytes. Those bytes acquire protected authority only when a human merges the review PR. CANONICAL is never entered automatically.
core_claim_reopening_rule: A metadata hit, citation, consensus, or model judgment cannot reopen a core claim. A minimized reproducible contradiction satisfying exact canonical premises and negating the exact conclusion may trigger the smallest affected governed correction path; autonomous internal agreement alone is not external independence.
external_boundary: EFR remains separately preregistered and externally executed; living-repository discovery and autonomous internal review never count as EFR execution, external independence, or final external review.
